participant_id.Description: BIDS participant identifier matching participants.tsv and subject directories.

dose.Description: Total NeuroEPO dose from the source clinical table. Placebo participants were coded as dose = 0.

severity.Description: Ordinal clinical motor severity grade from the source assessment table.

age.Description: Age in years at the assessment session.

progression.Description: Study-coded disease duration/progression value from the source clinical table.

education.Description: Study-coded education value from the source clinical table.
